'''Jaq Lounalt''' was a torturer from [[Tarabon]] and a [[Darkfriend]].

== Appearanace ==
He was lean with huge mustaches.{{ref/book|10|15}}

== Activities ==
===With Arymilla Marne===
Jaq Lounalt was in the employ of [[Arymilla Marne]] and resided in her camp outside [[Caemlyn]].{{ref/book|10|15}} After she took Caemlyn, Arymilla planned on using Jaq to coerce the [[High Seat]]s that were supporting [[Elayne Trakand]] to support her as queen of [[Andor]].{{ref/book|11|17}}

===With Sylvase Caeren===
When [[Sylvase Caeren]] takes over as [[High Seat]] of [[House Caeren|her house]], she pledges her support to Elayne and the use of Jaq in the questioning of Arymilla, [[Naean Arawn]], and [[Elenia Sarand]].{{ref/book|11|32}} Elayne uses Jaq's services to question [[Daved Hanlon|Doilin Mellar]] and the sisters of the [[Black Ajah]] that tried to kidnap her.{{ref/book|11|35}}{{ref/book|13|23}} 

===True allegiance===
Unknown to Elayne, Jaq was a Darkfriend and was secretly carrying messages to and from the sisters and planning their escape.{{ref/book|13|23}} When Elayne [[Mask of Mirrors|disguised]] herself as one of the [[Forsaken]] and attempted to get information out of [[Chesmal Emry]], Jaq tried to free the Black sisters. 

In the ensuing skirmish Elayne is badly injured, while Chesmal, [[Eldrith Jhondar]], and [[Temaile Kinderode]], were killed, while Jaq managed to flee the scene.{{ref/book|13|23}} His body is later found with a knife in the back.{{ref/book|13|24}}
